name: Johnny's Feather Repository
subtitle: Enhanced iOS clients curated for Feather
description: A personal Feather source maintained by JohnnyPh for selected enhanced iOS clients. Base apps and injected tweaks remain the work of their respective developers.

apps.name: YouTube + YTLite
apps.subtitle: YouTube with YTLite and playback fixes
apps.localizedDescription: YouTube enhanced with YTLite and its bundled tweak set. This test build includes YouFixPlaybackIssues 1.45 for playback errors, plus picture-in-picture, quality controls, interface controls, and other injected enhancements.

versions.localizedDescription: YouTube 21.13.6 with YTLite and the YouFixPlaybackIssues 1.45 test build.

apps.name: Reddit Deluxe
apps.subtitle: Reddit with a curated tweak collection
apps.localizedDescription: A customized Reddit build with RedditFilter, RedditSideloadFix, OLED keyboard support, colored comments, undo-scroll-up behavior, and the other tweaks bundled by the Reddit Deluxe project.

versions.localizedDescription: Reddit Deluxe 2026.26.0. Open its tweak settings with the project's three-finger hold gesture.

apps.name: Instagram + Sparkle
apps.subtitle: Instagram enhanced by Sparkle 1.1.0
apps.localizedDescription: Instagram bundled with Sparkle 1.1.0. Sparkle adds media downloads, a private on-device gallery, deleted-message recovery, profile analysis, per-account settings, privacy controls, and options to hide ads, Meta AI, and suggested content. Open Sparkle settings by long-pressing the Home tab or the Profile settings button.

versions.localizedDescription: Instagram 438.0.0 with Sparkle 1.1.0 and its sideload fix.

apps.name: Facebook + Glow
apps.subtitle: Facebook enhancer with a two-step login install
apps.localizedDescription: Facebook bundled with Glow 1.3.1. IMPORTANT: install version 563.0.0 first and sign in. Without deleting it, install version 570.0.0 over 563.0.0 to preserve the logged-in session. Glow adds media downloads, anonymous story viewing, accidental-action confirmations, privacy controls, and additional interface options. Long-press any tab to open Glow settings.

versions.localizedDescription: UPDATE STEP: After installing 563.0.0 and signing in, install this 570.0.0 build over it without deleting the app. This preserves the Facebook session.
LOGIN STEP: Install this build first and sign in. Then install Glow 570.0.0 over it without deleting the app.

apps.name: Messenger + Flow
apps.subtitle: Messenger enhancer with a two-step login install
apps.localizedDescription: Messenger bundled with Flow 1.0. IMPORTANT: install version 523.0.0 first and sign in. Without deleting it, install version 570.0.0 over 523.0.0 to preserve the logged-in session. Flow removes ads and selected clutter, adds privacy controls, supports story downloads, and adds call confirmation. If Feather cannot apply 570.0.0, the Flow release notes suggest trying LCSign.

versions.localizedDescription: UPDATE STEP: After installing 523.0.0 and signing in, install this 570.0.0 build over it without deleting the app. This preserves the Messenger session.
LOGIN STEP: Install this build first and sign in. Then install Flow 570.0.0 over it without deleting the app.

apps.name: EeveeSpotify
apps.subtitle: Spotify enhanced by EeveeSpotify Reincarnated
apps.localizedDescription: Spotify bundled with EeveeSpotify Reincarnated 6.6.6. This is the non-patched build supplied for sideloading and includes SpicyLyrics plus the tweak's other playback and interface enhancements.

versions.localizedDescription: Spotify 9.1.62 with EeveeSpotify Reincarnated 6.6.6 (non-patched sideload build).

apps.name: TikTok + r3tok
apps.subtitle: TikTok client with r3tok 1.8
apps.localizedDescription: TikTok bundled with the r3tok 1.8 modification and its in-app enhancement settings.

apps.name: YTMUltimate+
apps.subtitle: YouTube Music with YTMusicUltimate and extras
apps.localizedDescription: YouTube Music bundled with YTMusicUltimate 2.4.1 and YTMUltimate+ 1.0. Included extras add dislike counts, A/B configuration, picture-in-picture, and gesture-based volume boost controls.

versions.localizedDescription: YouTube Music 9.28.4 with YTMusicUltimate 2.4.1 and YTMUltimate+ 1.0.

apps.localizedDescription: SoundCloud bundled with SoundCloudPlus and ad-removal enhancements.
